detail: Full summary: triage spec §5 (its self-declared most important section) analyzes only the legacy file backend — SQLite is the v2 default, where the decision index is a read-time projection over full records: adding reversible is a one-line projection change in sqlite-stores.ts getIndex(), no migration/backfill/degraded machinery needed; an implementer following §5 literally would patch only the file writer and leave the default backend permanently degraded
